extracted.intended_audience: NIH peer reviewers (study section reviewers writing critiques)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for NIH peer reviewers on preparing and submitting critique documents using the Word critique templates provided for study section meetings. Covers software requirements, formatting/entry conventions, saving/uploading, and confidentiality/retention rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use current critique templates provided by the SRO
rubrics_metrics.description: The NIH scientific review officer (SRO) for your meeting provides templates for writing your critiques; the templates can be accessed via three locations in the Internet Assisted Review (IAR) module.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not use old templates saved on your computer from a previous review meeting, because policy and templates change frequently.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidance applies only to Word critique templates
rubrics_metrics.description: The following information does not apply to online critique templates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are using online templates, follow the separate online guidance rather than these Word-template instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Template format varies by award mechanism
rubrics_metrics.description: Critique template formats vary based on the award mechanism (i.e. training versus research project grants).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select and use the template that matches the specific award mechanism of the application you are reviewing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not unprotect and re-protect the document
rubrics_metrics.description: Critique templates contain drop-down fields and protected sections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not unprotect and re-protect the document because data loss may occur.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure compatible Microsoft Word version (especially Mac users)
rubrics_metrics.description: Mac users who experience difficulties with templates in Microsoft Word should ensure they have the latest version of Microsoft Word.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Updating Word can resolve template functionality issues on Macs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plain text templates available upon request
rubrics_metrics.description: Plain text versions of the templates (with reduced functionality) are available from the SRO upon request.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Request a plain text version if you cannot use the Word template; be aware functionality such as drop-downs will be reduced.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not record scores on templates unless instructed
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not record scores for overall impact or individual criteria on the templates, unless instructed to do so by the SRO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow SRO instructions about scoring; the standard Word template guidance cautions against entering scores.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enter comments directly into the template
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter your comments directly on to the template (instead of cutting and pasting), to retain bullets and formatting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you must paste text, use paste-special and choose 'unformatted text' to retain bullets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use hard returns to create bullets
rubrics_metrics.description: Use a hard return at the end of a bullet to create the next bullet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the template's expected bullet/linebreak behavior to keep formatting consistent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add identifying information (application number and PI names)
rubrics_metrics.description: Add the application number and Principal Investigator(s) name(s) at the top of the critique to help ensure that the critiques are correctly matched to the applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include these identifiers but avoid adding information that reveals your identity (see filename guidance).

rubrics_metrics.name: Document protection is necessary for form functionality
rubrics_metrics.description: Document protection is necessary to provide capabilities such as drop-down boxes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not remove protection; protected sections enable template features.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gray shading indicates a form field
rubrics_metrics.description: Gray shading indicates the presence of a form field to record your assessment (either as a drop-down selection or a comments field).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize shaded areas as interactive fields you should complete rather than accidental formatting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Spelling and grammar check unavailable in protected sections
rubrics_metrics.description: The Microsoft Word spelling and grammar check function is unavailable in protected sections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware that automatic checks may not run in some fields; proofread manually as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accept all changes before saving
rubrics_metrics.description: Before saving the critique, make sure to accept all changes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure tracked changes are resolved so the saved version is clean and consistent with template expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not password protect or encrypt critique documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not password protect or encrypt the document.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leave the file unencrypted so it can be uploaded and processed by IAR and SRO staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filename should be meaningful but not identity-revealing
rubrics_metrics.description: Save the template on to your computer, with a meaningful file name (but do not include any information that could reveal your identity).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use a filename that helps match critiques to applications without including reviewer-identifying information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Upload critiques to IAR and certify COI first
rubrics_metrics.description: Upload the critique to IAR (See written instructions or video tutorial). Note that until you have certified your pre-meeting conflict of interest certification in IAR, you will not be allowed to submit critiques or enter preliminary scores.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the IAR COI certification before attempting to submit critiques or scores.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delete critiques from local computer within 30 days
rubrics_metrics.description: Please delete all your critiques from your computer no later than 30 days after the review meeting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comply with NIH retention/confidentiality policies by removing local copies in a timely manner.
